newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Escudo slips vs mark, bank may have intervened.
newsitem.headline: Escudo slips vs mark, bank may have intervened.

text.p: The escudo came under early pressure against the mark on Friday and some dealers said that the Bank of Portugal may have been in the market to sustain the currency.
No official comment was immediately available from the central bank.

The escudo was trading at 101.38/41 to the German currency against an early 101.23/26, amidst international nervousness about a possible leftwing victory in Sunday's French elections and the row over the revaluation of Germany's gold.
Some dealers said that the Bank of Portugal had been a buyer of escudos at around 101.33 to the mark although others said that they had seen no activity yet by the central bank.
"We are going to have a session of selling pressure on the escudo, influenced by the fall of the French franc in the face of indications of a victory for the left next Sunday," said one trader.
"The tendency is for the escudo to ease against the mark but on the other hand one has to be cautious because of possible intervention by the Bank of Portugal," added another trader.
